podcast.title: 2000 Chart Presence
podcast.body: Mest was mentioned as a band appearing on the charts in 2000, representing a period where rock acts were perceived to often have only one or two good songs over several albums, contributing to a sense of unfulfillment among rock fans. "If you look at the charts for 2000, we have bands like Mest, Eve 6, Fuel, Oliander, Lifhouse, Primitive Radio Gods, the Presidents of the United States of America."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 00's Part 1: The Sad State of Rock
